name: request-response-cellular-fast-4g
description: Windowed RPC through a shaped pipe at a fast-4G cellular wire (10 Mbps, 60 ms one-way): the interactive pattern on a plausible mobile hop where round-trip delay dominates throughput. Requests per second is window-bound physics; the protocol's job is to add little on top.
conformance: sent == delivered + timeouts; the reference's send-before-register race (see request-response) is latency-shielded here - the wire's round trip dwarfs the registration gap
